Km. Vidushi vs State Of U.P And Another on 21 March, 2023
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 13395 of 2022
Applicant :- Km. Vidushi

Opposite Party :- State Of U.P And Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Ramendra Pratap Singh,Alok Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Araf Khan,Sonakshi Arora
Hon'ble Mrs. Jyotsna Sharma,J.
1. Heard Sri Alok Singh, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri O.P. Mishra, learned A.G.A. for the
State and perused the record.
2.

The instant anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant with a prayer to
release her on anticipatory bail in Case Crime No. 0586 of 2021, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 406
Ipc and Sections 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Gandhi Park, District Aligarh.

3.  As per prosecution case, the applicant who is 'nanad' has been continuously harassing her sister in-law (daughter of the first informant) for bringing additional dowry; it is alleged therein that she and other members of the family demanded money for confirming her brother in job.

4. It is contended on behalf of the applicant that she is innocent and the matter has arisen out of domestic disputes and disagreements between her sister in-law (bhabhi) and her brother; it is further contended that her sister-in-law has filed multiple cases against the applicant and her family members under Section 125 Cr.P.C., Section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act, two other complaint cases under different sections and also case relating to domestic violence; it is further contended that this FIR has been lodged by father of her sister-in-law just to exert pressure; it is also pointed out that proceedings in this case were stayed by coordinate Division Bench of this Court vide order dated 12.01.2022 in Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. 11681 of 2021; the facts regarding commission of offences under Section 377 and 376 IPC are absolutely false and have been inserted just to torture them so that the husband's side gives in and she may have her way; the applicant is having no Km. Vidushi vs State Of U.P And Another on 21 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/134225599/
1 criminal history and shall abide all the conditions, if any, imposed by this Court.

entities.text: Km. Vidushi vs State Of U.P And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that chargehseet has been filed on 19.09.2022.
5. The application for anticipatory bail is opposed by learned AGA for the State, however the broader contours of the case could not be rebutted.

6. In case of Siddharam Satlingappa Mhetre v. State of Maharashtra, (2011) 1 SCC 694, it has been held by the Supreme Court that while deciding anticipatory bail, Court must consider nature and gravity of accusation, antecedent of accused, possibility of accused to flee from justice and that Court must evaluate entire available material against the accused carefully and that the exact role of the accused has also to be taken into consideration.

entities.text: Siddharam Satlingappa Mhetre v. State of Maharashtra, (2011) 1 SCC 694
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 7. In the instant case, I considered submissions of the learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusation, role of applicant and all attending facts and circumstances of the case.
In my view, a case for anticipatory bail is made out.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the court below shall have the liberty to cancel the bail granted to the applicant.
10. It is made clear that observations made herein shall not in any way affect the learned trial Judge in forming his independent opinion at any stage of the case based on material before him.

Order Date :- 21.3.2023 Asha  Km. Vidushi vs State Of U.P And Another on 21 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/134225599/
